page_title: 客户端-APP通过热点连接预览视频
page_content:
#### 前提条件：
- 设备带WiFi模块，切换成AP模式即可连接，设备不带WIFI模块，可在USB口插入E-set进行热点连接
- 下载安装好APP，下载地址查看上面文档---平台软件下载 文章
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=495fc9af2faf4ee566b99ffcb219ac0b)

#### 操作步骤：
#####设备带WiFi模块
1、遥控进入菜单>>设置>>网络设置>>WiFi,进入WiFi配置界面
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ab06a1bdb61e6896fe617e162fef0c1e)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=915c81ab24825b68953f418530c27b0a)

2、移动到WiFi模式栏 选择AP模式，确认保存
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d45c78579fdc1a2d5df5864bcb388268)

#####设备插入E-set模块
1、把E-set插入到设备的usb口，设备会自动识别并切到到AP模式
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=eca0749b47221101c1d7a3eb904e9fde)

2、遥控按方向键来到网络状态可以查看AP模式状态
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=936f28bb9365f8cfbc05ca51ffc54cee)

#####连接使用
1、打开手机wifi连接“MDVR+设备号”名称的wifi，点击连接默认密码是99999999
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7698d72a5afa301c12537d74d0de4cd2)

2、手机连上设备的wifi热点后点击‘搜索’按钮
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=18c56d9701d50b71b31078d718b34508)

3、进去后点击连接wifi的设备号
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=aa4ad95a759d34e2c7a7c4c659609bc6)

4、默认界面预览通道画面
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b052a79fa0023a3a76d74d0bb3fa1346)

5、底部导航栏分别有 回放菜单、更多（WEB菜单）配置使用
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=85b987a17eae1e2a1db43ff7cf849698)![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=5f492c2f7f41bb5068b6fbe49aba6b86)
